# proxmox_node_ceph_start (Resource)

Starts a Ceph service through `POST /nodes/{node}/ceph/start`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_node_ceph_start" "osd" {
  node     = "pve"
  service  = "osd.0"
  triggers = { revision = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)
- `service` (String)
- `triggers` (Map of String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `upid` (String)
